title: Gandzelo Ra Ku Tiyimisela
intro: Enkarhini wa miringo ya Xikwembu, moya-xiviri a wu vitaniwa eka xiendlo xo hetelela xa ku titsongahata. Leswi a kuriseriweke etikweni leri nga riki na nchumu, xifaniso lexi xi kule xi va ni ripfumelo ni ku lehisa mbilu. Loko xivono xi lerisa gandzelo, a va tsekatsekanga. Mhaka ya vona i ribye ra xisekelo ra ku tinyiketela.
clues: A ndzi ri nhlamulo ya xikhongelo lexi a xi rindzeriwile nkarhi wo leha xa muprofeta lonkulu.
Mina na manana hi sale hi ri enkoveni lowu nga riki na nchumu hi ri ni malunghiselelo ya ti dates ni mati ntsena.
Ndzi kule ndzi va muprofeta la tivekaka hi ku vula ntiyiso ni ku lehisa mbilu.
Ndzi pfune tatana ku tlakusa masungulo ya yindlu yo kwetsima leyi nyiketeriweke eka Allah.
Loko tatana a ndzi byela hi norho wo ndzi endla gandzelo, ndzi hlamule ndzi ku, ‘Endla hilaha u lerisiweke hakona.
Allah u xixime ku titsongahata ka mina hi ku rhumela khuna leri humaka empfhukeni leswaku ri ta ndzi kutsula.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku titsongahata hi ku tirhandzela leswaku u endliwa magandzelo
trial.answer: Ku titsongahata hi ku tirhandzela leswaku u endliwa magandzelo

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
